question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Keen
solution:
The correct answer is **enthusiastic**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Keen: **very interested in something; wanting to do something. (किसी बात में बहुत रुचि रखने वाला)
 
• **Enthusiastic:** full of excitement and interest in something. ((किसी वस्‍तु या कार्य के विषय में) उत्‍साहपूर्ण)
 
• Thus, the most appropriate synonym of the given word is option 2&l
